name: 03053 · Londonderry, NH
findings: ZIP 03053 (Londonderry) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03053 (Londonderry) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 03053 (Londonderry) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
